title: Library screens and UI flow
idea: The library frontend is three screens: catalog, book detail and my loans. One reducer owns borrow and reserve state; each borrow carries an Idempotency-Key.
points: `BookDetail` renders state and dispatches; the `bookAction` reducer owns every rule.
A 409 NO_COPY switches the button to Reserve instead of showing a dead end.
A retry reuses the first Idempotency-Key, so a slow network never lends twice.
Follow-ups: multiple branches, push notifications, and search over millions of titles.

edges.caption: Picking a search result opens BookDetail with the title and its free copy count.

edges.label: reads, dispatches
edges.caption: BookDetail reads the reducer state and dispatches events. The free count decides Borrow or Reserve.

edges.label: borrow
edges.caption: Borrow sends POST /loans once; the step becomes BORROWING, so repeat clicks do nothing.

edges.label: no copy
edges.caption: On 409 NO_COPY the reducer switches to Reserve mode and explains why.

edges.label: reserve
edges.caption: Reserve sends POST /reservations. An 'already reserved' 409 still counts as success.
The API runs the service transaction: lock a free copy, insert the loan, commit.
MyLoansPage lists open loans with due dates, overdue badges and any fine owed.

edges.label: renew
edges.caption: Renew is refused with 409 when someone reserved the title; the row shows that reason.

code.title: Borrow and reserve reducer
code.caption: Pure screen logic. Run it, then add a BORROW_OK event after the retry and predict the line.

walk.text: The whole action state: step, Borrow or Reserve mode, key, loan and message.
Loading the book picks the mode from the free copy count.
Borrow starts only from IDLE and keeps the first key it was given.
A 409 NO_COPY clears the key and offers Reserve instead.
A network error keeps the key for the retry; any other failure clears it and shows the reason.
Already reserved is treated as success: the member is in the queue.
Double clicks, a network failure, a lost race and a duplicate reserve.

code.title: BookDetail component
code.caption: A React component that renders state and dispatches events. Not run here.

walk.text: Ignore clicks in flight; create the key once and reuse it on retry.
Map the response: network error, NO_COPY, other failures, or the new loan.
No book yet means a loading state, never an empty page.
Messages render in a status region that screen readers announce.
One button at a time: Borrow while copies are free, Reserve otherwise.

pitfalls: Disabling the button is not enough; the reducer and Idempotency-Key also stop repeats.
Do not show a free count as a promise; the borrow call can still return 409.
Interview follow-up: per-branch copies add a branch_id and change the free-copy query.

quiz.q: In the run, what key does the retry after NETWORK_ERROR use?
quiz.why: BORROW_CLICKED keeps `s.key` when it is set. NETWORK_ERROR does not clear it, so the retry still sends k-1.

takeaway: One reducer owns the screen; one key per borrow survives every retry.
